home.emptyBody: Add your child: name, grade and school — about a minute. Only you decide who sees the reports.
home.loadErrorBody: The server didn’t respond. Your data is safe — reload the page.

invites.title: Invitations for you
invites.sub: These were sent to the phone number you signed in with.
invites.coGuardian: {inviter} invites you as a co-guardian of {child}

child.reportBody: The report appears once the first wave has been taken and measured. Until then there are no numbers here — we don’t show guesses.
child.deletionBody: The profile will be anonymised on the scheduled date. If you’ve changed your mind, you can cancel the request.
child.coNote: The owner, {owner}, manages this profile. You can see the details but not change them.
child.schoolSub: Every change stays in the history: older waves are counted in their own grade and region.
child.historyEmpty: No school record yet. Add the school and grade below.
child.formSub: A new record is added; the previous one stays in the history.
child.schoolsEmpty: There’s no school list for this region yet — save with “not listed”.
child.schoolsError: The school list didn’t load. Choose the region again.
child.regionCap: Choose the region of the school, not your home: your child is compared with children in the same region.
child.errSchoolRegion: That school isn’t in this region. Choose the region and school again.
child.errPending: Data deletion has been requested — school records can’t be changed.
child.pendingLocked: While a deletion request is pending, school and grade can’t be changed.
child.coSchoolNote: The profile owner changes the school and grade.
child.accessBody: Who can see reports, tutor access, co-guardians and consents.
child.loadErrorTitle: The child’s profile couldn’t be loaded
child.loadErrorBody: The server didn’t respond. Your data is safe — reload the page.

invite.titleCo: {inviter} invites you to be a co-guardian of {child}
invite.co2: You can start waves in kid mode.
invite.co3: The owner, {inviter}, manages consents and tutor access.
invite.own1: You become the owner: consents, tutor access and data deletion requests are yours.
invite.own2: {inviter} becomes a co-guardian: sees reports but can’t change anything.
invite.own3: Current consents and tutor access stay as they are.
invite.declineBody: This link will stop working. If you change your mind, ask {inviter} to send a new invitation.
invite.declinedBody: Nothing has changed. If you change your mind, ask {inviter} to send a new invitation.
invite.expiredBody: Invitations are valid for a limited time. Ask the sender to send a new one.
invite.usedTitle: This invitation is no longer active
invite.usedBody: It has already been accepted, declined or cancelled by the sender.
invite.notFoundBody: This invitation isn’t for this number or no longer exists. Ask the sender to invite the number you signed in with.
invite.errorBody: The server didn’t respond. Reload the page.
invite.errAlready: You already have access to this child.
invite.onboardingSub: Someone invited you as a guardian of their child. Accept to open the family workspace.
